ValidationRule.description: Demo rule: VIC bond cap of one month's rent (weekly rent x 52 / 12) when weekly rent is $900 or less. Illustrative only.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Property_State__c, "VIC" ), NOT( ISBLANK( Weekly_Rent__c ) ), NOT( ISBLANK( Bond_Amount__c ) ), Weekly_Rent__c <= 900, Bond_Amount__c > Weekly_Rent__c * 52 / 12 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For VIC properties with rent of $900 per week or less, the bond cannot exceed one month's rent (demo rule).
